article.title: Power to set aside ex parte orders.
article.content: Where an order is passed by the National Commission ex parte, the aggrieved party may make an application to the Commission for setting aside such order.
article.html:
61Power to set aside ex parte orders.

Section 61 · Chapter IV · page 27 of the Act

Where an order is passed by the National Commission ex parte, the aggrieved party may make an application to the Commission for setting aside such order.
